page.layout: One page of text, with a running head at the top; a printed-over ghost text of another page shows faintly below and is not transcribed; a woodcut device (emblem with figure and inscriptions) in the centre; a catchword "CHR." at the lower right of the text area.

main_text.head: CAP. X.
main_text.p: Ei qui potest nos servare à peccato im- munes & statuere in conspectu gloriæ suæ inculpatos cum exsultatione, id est, soli sapienti Deo servatori nostro, gloria ma- gnificentia & robur & potestas & nunc & in omnia secula, Amen.
main_text.head: FINIS.

page.notes: The woodcut device shows a standing figure with a shield and a spear, inscribed "EST" / "TRIPLEX" / "CONCORDIA" / "PAX" around a circular border; it is an emblem, not text. The lower-right "CHR." is a catchword. Faint show-through of the reverse page is ignored. Transcription of the running head "CAP. X." is taken as the chapter marker, with "Theol. Crypt." as the running title.
